notes: Convertible = pmot clip PROVEN identical to a general-bank motion (root-stream match, maxDev ~0.01 mm) with matching frame count. Name matching alone is NOT proof: the bridge tested same-name pairs and most failed the root gate.
moveset_performable_from_general: named moves the fighter PERFORMS from the general pool (its own-bank clip for that name is a different motion). Separate from pmot-clip coverage.

The 5 no-bank names (cbco_screw_r, moco_d_jumpk_f/_y1/_y2, moco_doubleairk_f) have no source bank in the shipped disc (BANK-COMPLETION.md); only a PCSX2 runtime capture could source them. None of the 1,151 pmot clips carries these names — they are moveset-level gaps (motdat records with no clip in any bank).

2 of the 5 convertible pmot clips are UNNAMED in their bank (char005 ur_m022/ur_m023) — the motion identity was proven by root stream, not by name. Their general twins are named moco_golemnage1_f/_y, but the pmot clips themselves keep ur_name null (never guessed).
41 proxy-only fighters (no native animation) are not in the 1,151 (those are the 31 fighters with pmot banks); they can only use general-pool motions.
_f = P1 attacker half, _y = P2 receiver half (fighting-game convention; suffix semantics not confirmed in teardown docs).
D3 (which UR moves enter the library) and D5 (verbatim vs Bannon-rename) are Mars calls — not decided here.
